title: prove local object trust from descriptor manifest signature freshness and drift-zero

criteria: Object trust requires drift-zero, descriptor/manifest consistency, public signature, revocation, freshness, compatibility, rollback, and support references.
Endpoint reachability, frontend output, signer reachability, TUI output, shell output, and model replay are not trust.
Install, activation, rollback, support upload, and production mutation remain disabled unless all gates are proved.
